name: Stock Trend Agent
postCreateCommand: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
postAttachCommand: bash -lc 'pgrep -f "streamlit run web/app.py" >/dev/null || (nohup streamlit run web/app.py --server.port 8501 --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.headless true > /tmp/streamlit.log 2>&1 &)'
